message: We're back to a tentative peace. There's some occasional hissing, but the doors in the house are open again, the food and water dishes and litter boxen are back in their proper places, and Zeugma can stop hitting repeat on the CD player for track 9 of Journey's greatest hits. And Joanna, now that you mention it, Tink is the one who does freak out from time to time. Her knee's still bothering her, but I don't want to take her to the vet -- always a scary time, as Donna notes -- when things are still uneasy for her. And I don't know how much the vet could do, aside from massaging the leg and perhaps helping pop that kneecap back into place, although Tink seems to do a good job of that on her own. Still, she hobbles a bit, and there's clear weakness when she tries to jump.
